name: @xforge/cli
description: Git-native control plane for governed AI-assisted software development

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-diagnostics.mjs && node scripts/copy-license.mjs && node scripts/copy-scaffold.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:lock && vitest run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run check:lock && node scripts/run-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:product: npm run build && npm run check:lock && vitest run --root .. tests
scripts.verify: npm run check:scaffold && npm run build && npm run check:lock && node scripts/run-coverage.mjs && vitest run --root .. tests && npm run check:red-first
